name: Paseah
overview: Paseah, also known as Phaseah, is identified in Scripture as a son of Eshton and the father of Jehoiada, linking him to the lineage of the men of Rechah. His descendants are noted among those who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity, emphasizing the continuity of God's people through exile and restoration. The involvement of Jehoiada, son of Paseah, in repairing the old gate of Jerusalem highlights the active role this family played in rebuilding and reestablishing the community after captivity.
